steps.title: Unprivileged local execution in container
steps.text: An unprivileged local or containerized process begins the exploit attempt.

steps.title: AF_ALG / algif_aead + splice() interaction
steps.text: Process creates AF_ALG sockets and uses unusual cryptographic-socket and splice() sequences.
steps.description: Process creates AF_ALG sockets and uses unusual cryptographic-socket and splice() sequences.

steps.title: Page-cache corruption to root
steps.text: Controlled page-cache corruption yields root (UID 0) execution.
steps.description: Controlled page-cache corruption yields root (UID 0) execution.

steps.title: Escape to host namespace
steps.text: Because the page cache is shared, the attacker escapes the container boundary to the host.
steps.description: Because the page cache is shared, the attacker escapes the container boundary to the host.

steps.title: Detect container-to-host privilege transition
steps.text: Blue team correlates container AF_ALG socket activity with subsequent root execution or host-namespace access by the same workload.
steps.description: Blue team correlates container AF_ALG socket activity with subsequent root execution or host-namespace access by the same workload.

steps.title: Drain, patch and rebuild nodes
steps.text: SOC drains/isolates unpatched nodes, applies kernel updates, refreshes node images and rebuilds on suspected escape.
